title: fluid slit — hand-torn curl
description: Kraft paper with 6 hand-placed slits of irregular length, angle, and position. Each flap curls with a non-uniform bend radius (tight at tip, gentle at hinge). Independent breathing rates make each flap feel alive. Dust motes drift near the lifted tips. Click to lift all flaps toward flat.
motion: slow breathing per flap + scene air-drift + dust motes
